name: Holy Water
description: Water blessed by divine powers, harmful to undead and fiends.
notes: In combat: throw it at a foe (Dexterity attack, range 2/3 squares): 2d6 radiant to undead and fiends on a hit; anything else just gets wet.
Used up whether it hits or not.
Spell component: used up when you cast a spell that needs it. Free while a Reliquary is equipped.
